summary: Security-relevant patch: requires Go 1.26.10 for the eMudhra CA revocation and bumps jackson-databind, httpx2, express, vitest and x/net past open advisories.
CLI adds multi-field stream metadata and earlier `--jq` validation. Go SDKs add `EventStream.RawValue`; TypeScript gains MCP servers on SDK v2.
CLI adds custom pattern error messages and redacts sensitive bodies in diagnostics. Go and Terraform SDKs mask sensitive values in HTTP logs.
